decisions.label: Challenge columns: spacing (m)
decisions.note: How far apart the challenge circle's columns stand along its edge, one a kind of the island's roster (Ed, 2026-11-03: "the same number of columns as creature types"): the circle's radius is the larger of its radius knob (36 m) and kinds x spacing / 2 pi, so at 7.5 m the late home's 64 kinds make about 76 m, and its area grows to hold it.
